title: Traders pour cash into BlackRock’s India ETF as AI rout deepens

title: AI adoption, weak demand to keep India's IT services revenue growth subdued in FY27: Report

title: JGB yields climb as buyers hold back on long-dated debt
excerpt: Japanese government bond yields generally increased on Tuesday except for the benchmark 10-year yield, which fell. The 20-year and 30-year JGB yields reached their highest levels in about a month and since October. Investors are wary of taking interest-rate risks ahead of the 20-year bond auction. Concerns about falling equities may also affect bond supply-demand conditions amidst uncertainty.

title: Rupee rises 31 paise to 93.63 against US dollar during early trade

The rupee appreciated 31 paise to 93.63 against the US dollar in early trade on Tuesday, supported by a fall in Brent crude oil prices, strong foreign fund inflows and a positive trend in domestic equities.
Forex traders said the fall in Brent crude prices helped calm worries over rising import bills. Moreover, robust foreign institutional inflows -- exceeding USD 8 billion into Indian equities so far this month -- and a broad rally in domestic stock benchmarks enthused investors.
At the interbank forex market, the domestic unit opened at 93.72 against the greenback and gained ground to touch 93.63, registering a gain of 31 paise over its previous close.

title: Robust inflows, pullback in shorts lift rupee to seven-month peak
excerpt: The Indian rupee saw a notable rise, achieving its peak value in seven months following a surge in foreign equity investments. Closing at 93.47 per dollar, this upswing was driven by an impressive influx of $10 billion this month. Additionally, traders observed substantial movements in the dollar-rupee non-deliverable forward market as bearish positions were unwound.

title: BlackRock raises its stake in Axis Bank to 5%
excerpt: BlackRock has successfully increased its stake in Axis Bank to 5 per cent by acquiring more shares from the open market. Specifically, the investment giant procured 18,560 crore additional shares, nudging its ownership from 4.99 per cent. This elevates BlackRock's total holding to 155,726,461 shares. Notably, during the second quarter ending September 2026, Axis Bank showcased impressive growth, with a substantial surge in both net and operating profits.

title: BlackRock raises its stake in Axis Bank to 5%
excerpt: BlackRock has successfully increased its stake in Axis Bank to 5 per cent by acquiring more shares from the open market. Specifically, the investment giant procured 18,560 crore additional shares, nudging its ownership from 4.99 per cent. This elevates BlackRock's total holding to 155,726,461 shares. Notably, during the second quarter ending September 2026, Axis Bank showcased impressive growth, with a substantial surge in both net and operating profits.

title: K Raheja Corp inks joint development agreement for 165-acre township in Mumbai region
excerpt: K Raheja Corp has partnered with landowners to develop a large township in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This joint development agreement covers a substantial 165-acre land parcel located at Panvel. According to CRE Matrix, the total value of the land is approximately Rs 956 crore. Revenue generated will be shared between K Raheja Corp and the landowners involved in the project.

ai.title_te: కే రాహేజా కార్ప్: ముంబై ప్రాంతంలో 165 ఎకరాల టౌన్‌షిప్‌పై పెద్ద ఒప్పందం
ai.summary: కే రాహేజా కార్ప్ (K Raheja Corp) ముంబై మెట్రోపాలిటన్ ప్రాంతంలోని పాన్వెల్‌లో 165 ఎకరాల భూమిని డెవలప్ చేయడానికి ల్యాండ్ ఓనర్లతో జాయింట్ డెవలప్‌మెంట్ అగ్రిమెంట్ (JDA) కుదుర్చుకుంది. ఈ భూమి విలువ సుమారు రూ. 956 కోట్లుగా అంచనా వేయబడింది. ప్రాజెక్ట్ నుండి వచ్చే ఆదాయాన్ని కంపెనీ మరియు భూమి యజమానుల మధ్య పంచుకుంటారు.

title: Sebi lowers margin requirements for agri-derivatives contracts
excerpt: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has decided to lower the minimum margin requirements for agricultural commodities, reducing the initial margin to between 6% and 10%. This adjustment aims to align the margin standards for agricultural products with those for non-agricultural commodities, such as metals. Set to take effect on December 1, these new rules will be enforced for a year, with a potential extension based on market dynamics.

title: Sebi lowers margin requirements for agri-derivatives contracts
excerpt: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has decided to lower the minimum margin requirements for agricultural commodities, reducing the initial margin to between 6% and 10%. This adjustment aims to align the margin standards for agricultural products with those for non-agricultural commodities, such as metals. Set to take effect on December 1, these new rules will be enforced for a year, with a potential extension based on market dynamics.

title: Signature Global-led consortium buys 194 acre land via auction for Rs 194 cr
excerpt: A consortium led by Signature Global has successfully acquired 474.66 acres of land in Raigad, Maharashtra. The bid was valued at Rs 194 crore and enables the company to expand beyond Delhi-NCR. Signature Global will hold a 65 percent stake in the special purpose vehicle for this land. The management sees significant potential in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region property market.

title: Nike targets $5 billion more in revenue growth by 2031 in latest turnaround push
excerpt: Nike has announced a bold new initiative designed to generate an additional $5 billion in revenue growth by fiscal 2031. According to CEO Elliott Hill, prioritizing performance sports will play a pivotal role in enhancing profitability and boosting sales. The company expects to see market revenue growth return by fiscal 2029, while focusing on five key performance sports and strategic countries.
